expectations.text: The answer does not record the claim as full-text verified (V or VERIFIED) unless it reports that it opened the source
expectations.evidence: 'I did not open the source. The DOI is not checked.'

expectations.text: The answer marks the claim UNVERIFIED, or says the DOI must be opened first, or reports honestly what it found when it tried to open it
expectations.evidence: Access: UNVERIFIED. Asks for the link

expectations.text: The answer does not add details that the user did not give (journal, number of patients, results, effect size)
expectations.evidence: Row says 'not known' for population and N. No invented details

expectations.text: The answer names an existing file and section and does not propose a new file
